description_en: Modifies the configurations of an HTTP listener
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-load-balancer-http-listener-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1qjwo61pqz3ah00000 --listener-port 80 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SLB instance.

You can obtain the region ID from the Regions and zones list or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27585.html列表或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the SLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

-1: For an Internet-facing SLB instance with traffic-based billing, you can set the maximum bandwidth to -1, which means the bandwidth is not limited.

<props="china">- 1 to 5120 (Mbit/s): For an Internet-facing SLB instance with bandwidth-based billing, you can configure the maximum bandwidth for each listener. However, the sum of the maximum bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the maximum bandwidth of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85930.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
监听的带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。取值：

-1：对于按流量计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以将带宽峰值设置为-1，即不限制带宽峰值。

<props="china">- 1~5120（Mbps）：对于按带宽计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以为每个监听设置带宽峰值，但所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值。详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85930.html。</props>
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header to retrieve the originating IP address of the client request. Valid values:
on (default): yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段获取客户端请求的真实IP。取值：
on（默认值）：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

wrr: Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests.

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable session persistence. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启会话保持。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: sticky_session

parameters.help_en:
The method used to handle cookies. Valid values:

insert: insert cookie.

 When a client accesses the SLB instance for the first time, the SLB instance uses the insert cookie method (by inserting SERVERID into the HTTP/HTTPS response message). The next time the client accesses the SLB instance with this cookie, the SLB instance forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.

server: rewrite cookie.
 
 When the SLB instance detects a user-defined cookie, it rewrites the original cookie. The next time the client accesses the SLB instance with the new cookie, the SLB instance forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.
 
This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie的处理方式。取值：

insert：植入Cookie。

 客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie（即在HTTP/HTTPS响应报文中插入SERVERID），下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

server：重写Cookie。
 
 负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。
 
当StickySession的值为on时，必须指定该参数
parameters.name: sticky_session_type

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of the cookie.

Valid values: 1 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to insert
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie超时时间。

取值：1~86400秒。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为insert时，该参数必选
parameters.name: cookie_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The cookie configured on the server.

The cookie must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain only ASCII letters and digits. It cannot contain commas (,), semicolons (;), or spaces, and cannot start with a dollar sign ($).

This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to server
parameters.help_zh:
服务器上配置的Cookie。

长度为1~200字符，只能包含ASCII英文字母和数字字符，不能包含半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）或空格，也不能以美元符号（$）开头。
  

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为server时，该参数必选
parameters.name: cookie

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the health check feature. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: health_check

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP method used for health checks. Valid values: head and get.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：head或get。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_method

parameters.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:
    
$_ip: the private IP of the backend server. If $_ip is specified or HealthCheckDomain is not specified, the SLB instance uses the private IP of each backend server as the domain name for health checks.

domain: The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名，取值：
    
$_ip： 后端服务器的私网IP。当指定了$_ip或HealthCheckDomain未指定时，负载均衡会使用各后端服务器的私网IP当做健康检查使用的域名。

domain：域名长度为1~80字符，只能包含字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_domain

parameters.help_en:
The URI used for health checks.

The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URI cannot be only a forward slash (/) but must start with a forward slash (/).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。

长度限制为1~80字符，只能使用字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、半角问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）字符。URI不能只为正斜线（/），但必须以正斜线（/）开头。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_uri

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before the health status of a backend server is changed from fail to success.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail判定为success。

取值：2~10。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before the health status of a backend server is changed from success to fail.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success判定为fail。

取值：2~10。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for a health check response. If a backend Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance does not send a correct response within the specified timeout period, the health check fails. This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on.

Valid values: 1 to 300. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效。

取值：1~300秒
parameters.name: health_check_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。

取值：1~50秒。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查使用的端口。

取值：1~65535。

当HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status codes that indicate a successful health check. Separate multiple HTTP status codes with commas (,).

Valid values: http_2xx, http_3xx, http_4xx, and http_5xx.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查正常的HTTP状态码，多个状态码用半角逗号（,）分割。

取值：http_2xx、http_3xx、http_4xx或http_5xx。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_http_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a vServer group is used. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用虚拟服务器组。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: vserver_group

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vServer group
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组ID
parameters.name: vserver_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-IP` header to retrieve the virtual IP address (VIP) of the client request. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-IP`头字段获取客户端请求的VIP（Virtual IP address）。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slb_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header to retrieve the SLB instance ID. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-ID`头字段获取负载均衡实例ID。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slb_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header to retrieve the listener protocol of the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_proto

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable `Gzip` compression to compress specific file types. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启`Gzip`压缩，对特定文件类型进行压缩。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: gzip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control list (ACL) associated with the listener.

This parameter is required when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听绑定的访问策略组ID。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数必选
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control type. Valid values:

white: a whitelist. Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. A whitelist applies to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access an application. Configuring a whitelist poses certain business risks. After a whitelist is configured, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the SLB listener.
 
 If you enable a whitelist but the access control policy group does not contain any IP addresses, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

black: a blacklist. All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are blocked. A blacklist applies to scenarios in which you want to block access from specific IP addresses to an application.

 If you enable a blacklist but the access control policy group does not contain any IP addresses, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

This parameter takes effect only when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制类型：

white： 仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。
 
 如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black： 来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。

 如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数有效
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制功能。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 15.

If no access request is received within the specified timeout period, the SLB instance temporarily breaks the current connection. When a new request arrives, the SLB instance establishes a new connection
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间，取值范围为1~60秒，默认值为15秒。

在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60.

If a backend server does not send a response within the specified timeout period, the SLB instance stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间，取值范围为1~180秒，默认值为60秒。

在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en: The description of the listener
parameters.help_zh: 设置监听的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `XForwardedFor_SLBPORT` header to retrieve the listener port of the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_SLBPORT`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slbport

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort` header to retrieve the port of the client that accesses the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_client_src_port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: The request is prechecked but not executed. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): The request is prechecked. If the request passes the precheck, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会执行操作。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 `DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
